query: This project has a Resonance ownership manifest from an older compiled installation. A new release adds .forge, but the project already has an unowned .forge/forge.py with local tooling. Update it. Do I need to choose a profile or delete the local file?
expected_behavior: Uses the complete installation without asking the owner to choose a profile
Treats the old compiled manifest value only as evidence for the old release's ownership scope
Preserves an unowned existing .forge/forge.py and reports that exact path as a conflict rather than overwriting or deleting it
Allows newly included paths only when absent or when their bytes match the incoming release
Keeps the historical manifest profile available only while proving old release ownership
